description: This Java class defines a serializable entity called PersistableCustomerOption that extends CustomerOptionEntity and includes a list of CustomerOptionDescription objects, representing customizable options for customers.

classes.name: PersistableCustomerOption
classes.description: A Java class representing a persistable customer option with associated descriptions, extending CustomerOptionEntity and implementing Serializable.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of CustomerOptionDescription objects associated with this customer option.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of CustomerOptionDescription objects associated with this customer option.
